headline:
Huge growth,
unusually reasonable PEG
chart_note: 10-day range: $456.75 - $506.00, down about 8% over the window after an early-month high.
why_today: Down slightly today, consolidating after a strong month - revenue up 50% and earnings up 160% YoY on continued AI-chip demand.
pro_1: Earnings growing near 160% YoY on 50% revenue growth - among the fastest-growing large chipmakers
pro_2: PEG ratio of just 1.0 is unusually reasonable for this growth rate, despite a rich-looking 122x trailing P/E
con_1: Beta of 2.49 means large price swings in both directions - this is not a low-volatility holding
con_2: Down about 8% over the past 10 days - worth watching whether that continues
